notes: Replace the old IsLattice hypothesis with IsFullLattice. The old class required finite generation and full span; the new IsLattice no longer requires full span. Here E is the fraction field of its ring of integers, so the additional scalar-extension condition in the new IsLattice follows from finite generation by Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg. IsFullLattice therefore preserves the original hypothesis, including the full-span condition used by the proof.
